functions.name: cut_interval
functions.done: Cuts a numeric vector into equal-range intervals and includes the lowest endpoint.

proof.python:
import json
import statistics
import sys
import time

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/ggplot2")
from ggplot2.cut_interval import cut_interval

x = list(range(1, 101))

def one():
    return cut_interval(x, 10)

value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
codes = [None if code is None else int(code) for code in value.codes]
print(json.dumps({"value": codes, "median_ms": [statistics.median(elapsed)]}))

functions.name: mean_cl_normal
functions.done: Returns the mean and normal confidence limits, the mean plus or minus qt((1 + conf.int) / 2, n - 1) standard errors.

check.case: mean_cl_normal of 100 standard normals drawn with set.seed(1)

proof.r:
lib <- tempfile("hmisc-lib-")
dir.create(lib)
src <- tempfile("Hmisc-")
dir.create(file.path(src, "R"), recursive = TRUE)
writeLines(c(
  "Package: Hmisc",
  "Version: 5.3-0",
  "Title: Harrell Miscellaneous",
  "Description: Exports smean.cl.normal as published in Hmisc 5.3-0.",
  "License: GPL (>= 2)",
  "Imports: stats"
), file.path(src, "DESCRIPTION"))
writeLines("export(smean.cl.normal)", file.path(src, "NAMESPACE"))
writeLines(c(
  "smean.cl.normal <- function(x, mult=qt((1+conf.int)/2,n-1),",
  "                            conf.int=.95, na.rm=TRUE)",
  "{",
  "  if(na.rm) x <- x[!is.na(x)]",
  "  n <- length(x)",
  "  if(n < 2)",
  "    return(c(Mean=mean(x),Lower=NA,Upper=NA))",
  "  ",
  "  xbar <- sum(x)/n",
  "  se <- sqrt(sum((x - xbar)^2) / n / (n-1))",
  "  c(Mean=xbar, Lower=xbar - mult*se, Upper=xbar + mult*se)",
  "}",
  ""
), file.path(src, "R", "smean.R"))
invisible(utils::capture.output(install.packages(src, repos = NULL, lib = lib, quiet = TRUE, type = "source")))
if (!dir.exists(file.path(lib, "Hmisc"))) stop("Hmisc install failed")
.libPaths(c(lib, .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))
if (packageDescription("ggplot2")$Version != "4.0.3") stop("expected ggplot2 4.0.3")
options(warn = -1)
set.seed(1)
x <- rnorm(100)
one <- function() {
mean_cl_normal(x)
}
value <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
nums <- as.numeric(unlist(value, use.names = FALSE))
cat(jsonlite::toJSON(list(value = nums, median_ms = median(elapsed) * 1000), auto_unbox = FALSE, digits = 17, na = "null"))

functions.name: resolution
functions.done: Returns 1 for an integer or constant vector, and otherwise the smallest gap larger than the square root of machine epsilon.

proof.python:
import json
import statistics
import sys
import time

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/ggplot2")
from ggplot2.resolution import resolution

eps = sys.float_info.epsilon
x = [1.0, 1.0 + 1000 * eps, 2.0]

def one():
    return resolution(x)

value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
if not isinstance(value, list):
    value = [value]
print(json.dumps({"value": value, "median_ms": [statistics.median(elapsed)]}))
